final.sample_inclusion: aged male WT vs C2-/- TA muscle, n = 4 per group (FIG8)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of Mybpc2 (fMyBP-C) knockout on TA muscle gene expression in aged (21-22 mo) male mice; genotype, not exercise

final.exercise_component: none: no training, running, or acute exercise arm in any RNA-seq dataset (S2.11.p1). The only contraction intervention in the paper (ECC injury, S2.3.p1) was analysed by Western blot/ELISA in C57BL/6 mice, not sequenced.
